card.line: Ephrathah is an old name for Bethlehem in Judah, the town linked to Boaz, Ruth, and King David's family line.

moments.title: A blessing at the gate
moments.text: After Boaz takes Ruth as his wife, the elders and the people at the gate bless him. They ask the LORD to make him prosperous in Ephrathah and famous in Bethlehem.

moments.title: News of the ark
moments.text: A psalm remembers that people heard the ark was in Ephrathah, and then found it in the fields of Jaar. It goes on to remember the LORD's promise to David about his throne.
